results.title: Conner Weigman’s 3 second-half touchdowns rally No. 20 Houston past UCF 27-17
results.description: HOUSTON -- Conner Weigman threw for 239 yards and rushed for three second-half touchdowns, and No. 20 Houston rallied to beat Central Florida 27-17 on Saturday.

results.title: 'Not a good sign': Shubman Gill highlights fielding lapses before 2027 World Cup, backs in-form Rohit Sharma-Virat Kohli
results.description: Shubman Gill has raised concerns over India's fielding lapses ahead of the 2027 ODI World Cup, calling them a worrying sign. The Indian captain also backed the in-form Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli, expressing confidence in the senior duo's experience and match-winning abilities.
